title: Env-gated integration tests via CORTEX_*_IT=1 early return
whenToUse: For integration tests that require a live external service (Vectorizer, Synap, Nexus, etc.) and should be opt-in in CI.
whenNotToUse: For pure-Rust tests that never hit the network — those should run unconditionally. Also not suitable when you need the test binary itself to exit non-zero on skip (use `#[ignore]` with a wrapper script instead).
